integrity: The source chain classification is specialized to the one-dimensional radical center; invertibility is derived by a rank-one determinant calculation, and composition is computed directly. A standalone checker verifies the finite-field group law and Hom-Jacobi identity in representative cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats upper triangular matrices of size at least three.
Only regular, hence invertible, Hom-Lie structures are classified.
The abstract group decomposition is extracted from an existing incidence-algebra classification rather than replacing that classification.
title: Regular Hom-Lie structures on upper triangular matrices form an explicit affine group
